Red Thai Curry Chicken

Ingredients

1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized chunks
1 tbsp coconut oil
1 can (14oz) coconut milk 
1 cup water
2-3 tbsp red curry paste
2 baby bok choy, chopped
1 red bell pepper, chopped coarsely
1" knob ginger, grated
1 cup snow peas, chopped coarsely
1 1/2 tsp brown sugar
2 tsp fish sauce
juice of 1 lime
1 tsp salt
cilantro
cooked rice for serving

Directions

  1. Heat the coconut oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium high heat. When hot, add the ginger and sauté until fragrant -- 2 minutes.

  2. Add the chicken and sear until not quite cooked through. Then, add the curry paste. Mix together and continue to sauté over high heat for another two minutes.

  3. Pour in the coconut milk and water, then add the bok choy, bell pepper, chopped snow peas.

  4. Bring curry to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer. Stir in the fish sauce, salt, lime juice and sugar. Continue simmering over medium/low heat until veggies are soft. This will take about 10 minutes.

Serve curry over (basmati rice), adding some cilantro leaves.
I use Maesri red Thai curry paste, which is more on the spicy/traditional side (from what I've been told).
